leo: quick note — bringing up harbor-lite-v2 embeddings. did a cluster-cohesion + recall@10 sweep on wiki-holdout and saw an odd tradeoff: recall largely OK but clustering metrics (silhouette / calinski) dropped a lot for short queries. dropping the quick numbers + commands.
tara: paste numbers + exact flags please.
leo: short paste: 
```
baseline: beacon-v2 fp16   recall@10 = 0.648  silhouette(mean) = 0.42  calinski = 1150
harbor-lite-v2 fp16        recall@10 = 0.639  (-0.009)  silhouette = 0.31  calinski = 870
harbor-lite-v2 int8 pchan  recall@10 = 0.635  (-0.013)  silhouette = 0.30
bootstrap 95ci recall@10 baseline = [0.644,0.652] harbor = [0.630,0.638]
mean pos cosine baseline = 0.79 -> harbor = 0.76
```
flags: `--model harbor-lite-v2 --holdout wiki --k 10 --norm l2 --coh-metrics silhouette,calinski --seed 202` vectors saved unnormalized; postproc L2 norm. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/harbor-lite/v2/cluster-sweep/\nvik: interesting that recall drop is small but silhouette collapses. that suggests tighter inter-class mixing even if gt still in top10 often. did you look at per-cluster purity or class-wise recall?
leo: yes — per-cluster purity (NMI-ish) dropped for small-length queries. split cohorts: short (<6 tokens) silhouette dropped from 0.39 -> 0.18 and short recall@10 -0.026 abs. medium and long cohorts show near-parity.
marta: any architecture/training diffs vs beacon? pooling/ln/embedding-dim changes?
leo: harbor-lite-v2 diffs: reduced hidden dim in projection (to 512), switched to gated-pool instead of mean-pool, trained with heavier temperature on contrastive loss. could affect cluster separation.
tara: how about cluster sizes? are some clusters exploding/merging?
leo: kmeans(k=128) cluster size entropy increased (more uneven); a few large clusters absorb many shortseq points. UMAP on 4k shortseq shows blobs merging. gist: https://gist.github.com/leo/harbor-lite-v2-umap (contains annotated examples).
vik: did you compute pairwise overlap of top10 between baseline and harbor? id-flip matrix?
leo: yes — top10 overlap overall 0.92 -> 0.86. for shortseq top10 overlap 0.91 -> 0.78. top1 overlap shortseq 0.80 -> 0.58. so many id-flips inside top10 for short queries.
marta: any changes in embedding norm distribution by length?
leo: shortseq norms mean: baseline 1.02 -> harbor 0.87 (after L2 renorm they look similar but raw logits differ). variance increased. plotted per-length norm CDFs in artifacts.
tara: quick mitigations: (A) index-time PCA-whiten (k=64) (B) per-dim mean-subtract + renorm (C) tweak contrastive temp lower (so harder positives) as an ablation.
leo: ran quick postprocs: mean-centering + renorm -> silhouette up to 0.26 and recall@10 -> 0.643. PCA-whiten k=64 -> silhouette 0.29 recall@10 0.645. so postproc recovers a lot of cohesion. ablation to reduce embedding dim back to 768 (from 512) will be run next.
vik: quant effect small? int8 only -0.004 vs fp16 on recall but silhouette also down slightly. try per-channel symmetric quant + percentile clip at 99.9.
leo: kicking ablation + quant sweep now. plan: 1) ablation: revert gated->mean pool and dim back to 768 2) quant calibs (6 configs) 3) generate topk-id-flip matrix + 100 sample failure cases for SRE/model teams 4) compute cluster-purity per-label for shortseq cohort. ETA ~45m.
ci-bot: onboard-eval pipeline started: job harbor-lite-v2-cluster-20260407-01. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/harbor-lite-v2-cluster-20260407-01/logs. artifacts will land in the s3 path above.
ops-bot: note: if we surface PCA-whiten as a Dedicated config, add warning about increased index build time and slightly higher index storage.
tara: good reminder. also capture cost/perf tradeoff in README of artifacts.
leo: will attach a small csv of 100 shortseq examples (query, gold-id, beacon-rank, harbor-rank, beacon-sim, harbor-sim) for model debugging. will post interim results when first ablation finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:
